# ---- Difficulty ramp across a round ----
# A round opens gently and works up
on a clock that restarts from zero every

# gameSetting.csv -- tunable game parame: # round. Three eras:
#   0 .. ramp_single_pipe_until   every column carries ONE pipe -- hanging
#                                 from the ceiling or standing off the floor
#                                 -- with open lane past it to fly round
#   .. ramp_two_pipe_by           columns gradually start arriving with both
#                                 pipes
#   ramp_tighten_at .. _by        that gap closes from wide down to tight
# Because the clock is per round rather than per match
# turn up in a run that actually lasts that long -- you have to stay alive
# two minutes on one life to reach the tightening. Lower the numbers here to
# see the whole curve sooner.
# ramp_single_pipe_until: seconds during which every column has one pipe
# only. The gentle opening.
ramp_single_pipe_until
# ramp_two_pipe_by: seconds by which every column has both pipes. Between
# this and ramp_single_pipe_until the two kinds are mixed
# columns getting steadily more likely. Forced to at least one second after
# ramp_single_pipe_until.
ramp_two_pipe_by
# ramp_tighten_at: seconds at which the opening starts shrinking from
# ramp_gap_wide toward ramp_gap_tight.
ramp_tighten_at
# ramp_tighten_by: seconds by which it has finished shrinking. Forced to at
# least one second after ramp_tighten_at.
ramp_tighten_by
# ramp_gap_wide: multiplier on pipe_gap_half_height for the whole early game
# up to ramp_tighten_at. Above 1 because a column with both pipes needs to be

ramp_gap_wide

ramp_gap_tight
